dedupe_keys.name: degradation detection and severity estimation by exploiting an optical time and frequency digital twin

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The model combines learned optical-constellation evolution in the time domain with analytical spectral evolution. It detects optical filter degradation and estimates severity. Companion metadata describe predicted signals and comparison of deep-learning-generated constellations with physical measurements. Coverage is the optical-layer model and its reported validation components, not an operating digital twin of a named carrier. The individual papers do not establish that all experiments use independent datasets or identical trained weights. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
